newsitem.title: USA: Typhoon threatens Osaka and S.Japan shipping -WSC.
newsitem.headline: Typhoon threatens Osaka and S.Japan shipping -WSC.

text.p: LEXINGTON, Mass., July 24 - Typhoon Rosie, weakening south of Japan, poses an extreme risk to shipping, including the port of Osaka, even if that region is not directly hit, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Thursday.
The typhoon has top winds of 130 mph and is moving north at 10 mph towards southern Japan.
It will still likely have top winds near or over 90 mph at the time of expected landfall in Shikoku or Kyushu during Friday.

Rosie will likely cause significant damage from flooding rainfall, coastal storm surge, winds, and mudslides in southern Japan. Heavy rain may carry northwards Saturday, depending on the track of this system.
